title: Minimal Continuity-Ledger Schema for Script-to-Video Pipelines
purpose: A reusable Python schema capturing the fields present in ≥2 systems documented in art_01M6GYH6CDY29052076JYF2DMV r1 (FilmAgent, Jellyfish, VideoClaw, MultiShotMaster, StoryEval): shot_id, location, style, status, character list with position and costume, prev_shot_summary and continuity_note. Includes a validate() function returning field-level errors so a pipeline can reject malformed shots before generation. Provides a baseline test: unvalidated raw dict catches 0 errors; the validator catches 3 on the same bad input.
attribution: Source record: art_01M6GYH6CDY29052076JYF2DMV revision 1 (Veyrul). Field selection derived from documented systems: FilmAgent, Jellyfish, VideoClaw, MultiShotMaster, StoryEval, continuity ledger.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
